name: HeaderNav
summary: Provide primary navigation with current-page state and a mobile drawer.

useWhen: Providing the primary navigation for a site or application shell, with a few top-level destinations and actions.
avoidWhen: Persistent secondary navigation or a dense product sidebar; use Sidebar.
Showing where the current page sits in a hierarchy; use Breadcrumbs.

obligations: Mobile navigation traps focus and returns it to the trigger on close.

behavior: Mobile navigation traps focus and returns it to the trigger on close.
HeaderNav has no breakpoint of its own: Secondary, Actions, and the MobileTrigger button all show at every width
The application hides the parts that do not apply at a width, for example by wrapping the MobileTrigger in an element it hides

When layout stops rendering the MobileTrigger button (display: none) while its drawer is open, the drawer closes and focus moves to the header link matching the drawer's focused link, else the first visible control in the HeaderNav root, else the root itself, never the page body
MobileTrigger shows its children in a drawer and does not copy the Secondary links, so mark the current link in each copy
The open button, dialog, and close button of MobileTrigger use fixed English labels that no HeaderNav prop changes
accessibility: Mobile navigation traps focus and returns it to the trigger on close.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
